atoms.statement: Integrate SceneStore.get_or_create and SceneStore.save into pipeline/live.py to update SceneModel (BackgroundPlate, SpatialGrid, FurnitureRegistry) on every frame.
atoms.test: Unit tests for SceneStore methods; integration test in `live.py` to ensure SceneModel is updated and saved.

atoms.statement: Introduce a wall-clock-based warmup guard (2-5 minutes, configurable) per camera_id before activating furniture suppression.
atoms.test: Unit tests for warmup logic (wall-clock vs. frame-count); integration tests verifying suppression is inactive during warmup.

atoms.statement: Implement VLM-gate suppression requiring BOTH a promoted-furniture class/IoU match AND near-zero motion (plate-diff) in the matched cells, gated by warmup. The plate-diff acts as a safety backstop for real persons.
atoms.test: Unit tests for suppression predicate (furniture match, motion score, warmup state); integration tests for VLM-gate behavior under various conditions (moving object, static furniture, person near furniture).

atoms.statement: Implement suppression as a single, explicit decision point in live.py that withholds both the VLM wake and the alert, yielding a suppressed PipelineEventResult.
atoms.test: Integration tests verifying that suppressed events do not trigger VLM or alerts, and the PipelineEventResult reflects suppression.

atoms.statement: Populate the FurnitureRegistry using the existing `_static_track_ids` signal from `events/builder.py`, making this signal durable and cross-restart via SceneModel.
atoms.test: Unit tests for FurnitureRegistry population logic; integration tests ensuring static tracks are correctly promoted to furniture.

atoms.statement: Ensure every decision atom is covered by `pytest` in `bridge-projects/oko`, with tests running green before architect review and chapter shipment.
atoms.test: CI/CD gate, code review check for test presence and pass.

atoms.statement: Cover SceneModel integration and VLM-gate suppression with unit and integration tests, including cases for warmup, promoted furniture, moving objects, and non-promoted detections.
atoms.test: Code review of test coverage, execution of specified tests.

atoms.statement: Prioritize and build only Chapter 2 (Stage-1 live integration) first, decomposing it into pure functions for scene update and suppression predicate, wiring, and a config section. Stages 2-5 will be separate, future chapters.
atoms.test: Codebase structure review, adherence to chapter scope.

atoms.statement: Implement a dedicated module for accumulating labeled crops from confirmed person/animal events in `runs/labels/<camera_id>/`, storing each crop with metadata JSON (vlm_description as provisional label, bbox, conf, cell, timestamp, camera_id, model_version).
atoms.test: Unit tests for data storage format; integration tests for event-to-crop capture.

atoms.statement: For Stage-2 training labels, use YOLO's own agreed bbox+class (confirmed by VLM/operator) rather than parsing VLM free-text descriptions into classes.
atoms.test: Code review of label generation logic; verification of label format.

atoms.statement: Implement a held-out evaluation harness that computes precision, recall, and confusion matrix on a frozen, automatically immutable split manifest of accumulated labels and current YOLO output.
atoms.test: Unit tests for metric computation; integration tests for manifest generation and data splitting.

atoms.statement: Export YOLO dataset to `runs/datasets/<version>/` (with images, labels, data.yaml, manifest.json), converting agreed detections to labels and furniture/confirmed-normal to hard negatives (empty label files).
atoms.test: Unit tests for dataset format compliance; integration tests for export process.

atoms.statement: Implement GPU fine-tuning as an out-of-band process (separate CLI/scheduled job) with preflight checks and fixed inputs (dataset_version, base_weights, train_config), never in the live inference loop.
atoms.test: Unit tests for preflight checks; integration tests for training job execution.

atoms.statement: Implement atomic model promotion: save old weights, place new weights, run held-out evaluation, and switch active pointer/config ONLY if new weights outperform current by a clear margin AND no per-class recall regresses beyond an epsilon. Otherwise, discard new weights.
atoms.test: Unit tests for promotion logic (metric comparison, rollback trigger); integration tests for atomic weight swap and config update.

atoms.statement: Implement rollback as an explicit command to restore previous active weights, with automatic rollback triggered upon failure of post-promotion validation.
atoms.test: Unit tests for rollback command; integration tests for auto-rollback on validation failure.

atoms.statement: Send a single Telegram confirmation after successful active model switch and promotion manifest recording.
atoms.test: Unit tests for notification trigger; integration tests for single notification delivery.
